metaTitle: Custom Sublimation Badge Reels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation badge reels with full-color designs. Perfect for employee IDs, events, and trade shows. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Custom sublimation badge reels let you print vibrant, full-color logos and artwork directly onto the reel body, creating a seamless look that stands out. Unlike standard imprint methods, sublimation allows for gradients, photos, and intricate details without color limitations. This makes them ideal for trade shows, corporate uniforms, or any setting where you want your brand to pop. Choose a durable dye-sublimated lanyard paired with a standard reel for a complete, professional ID solution.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation badge reel with full-color printed logo on a white reel, attached to a dye-sublimated lanyard.
